name: Property Set: Cable Carrier Segment Type Cable Ladder Segment
definition: Definition from IAI: An open carrier segment on which cables are carried on a ladder structure.

name: Property Set: Cable Carrier Segment Type Cable Tray Segment
definition: Definition from IAI: An (typically) open carrier segment onto which cables are laid.

name: Property Set: Cable Carrier Segment Type Cable Trunking Segment
definition: Definition from IAI: An enclosed carrier segment with one or more compartments into which cables are placed.

name: Property Set: Cable Carrier Segment Type Conduit Segment
definition: Definition from IAI: An enclosed tubular carrier segment through which cables are pulled.

name: Property Set: Cable Segment Type Cable Segment
definition: Definition from IAI: Electrical cable with a specific purpose to lead electric current within a circuit or any other electric construction. Includes all types of electric cables, mainly several electrical segments wrapped together, e.g. cable, tube, busbar. Note that the number of conductors within a cable is determined by an aggregation mechanism that aggregates the conductors within the cable.

name: Property Set: Cable Segment Type Conductor Segment
definition: Definition from IAI: An electrical conductor is a single linear element with the specific purpose to lead electric current. The core of one lead is normally single wired or multiwired which are intertwined.

name: Property Set: Electrical Circuit
definition: Definition from IAI: A circuit supplies electrical devices with voltage and current.

name: Property Set: Electrical Device Common
definition: Definition from IAI: A means of collecting together all properties that are commonly used by electrical devices.

name: Property Set: Electric Distribution Point Common
definition: Definition from IAI: A room or a place or a box where an electrical supply enters and is then further distributed via electrical circuits. A distribution point may be a main distribution point or a sub-main distribution point.

name: Property Set: Electric Generator Type Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Defines a particular type of engine that is a machine for converting mechanical energy into electrical energy.

name: Property Set: Electric Heater Type Electrical Cable Heater
definition: Definition from IAI: An electrical device that outputs heat uniformly along its path.

name: Property Set: Electric Heater Type Electrical Mat Heater
definition: Definition from IAI: An electrical device that outputs heat uniformly across its surface area.

name: Property Set: Electric Heater Type Electrical Point Heater
definition: Definition from IAI:  An electrical device that outputs heat as a total quantity from a point or restricted area that can be considered as a point.

name: Property Set: Electric Motor Type Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Defines a particular type of engine that is a machine for converting electrical energy into mechanical energy. Note that in cases where a close coupled or monobloc pump or close coupled fan is being driven by the motor, the motor may itself be considered to be directly part of the pump or fan. In this case , motor information may need to be specified directly at the pump or fan and not througfh separate motor/motor connection entities.

name: Property Set: Lamp Type Common
definition:
Definition from IAI: A lamp is a component within a light fixture that is designed to emit light. 

History: Name changed from Pset_LampEmitterTypeCommon in IFC 2x3.

name: Property Set: Light Fixture Type Exit Sign

name: Property Set: Light Fixture Type Thermal

name: Property Set: Outlet Type Common

name: Property Set: Protective Device Type Circuit Breaker
definition: Definition from IEC 441-14-20: A circuit breaker is a mechanical switching device capable of making, carrying, and breaking currents under normal circuit conditions and also making, carrying for a specified time and breaking, current under specified abnormal circuit conditions such as those of short circuit.

name: Property Set: Protective Device Type Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Common properties for different protective device types.

name: Property Set: Protective Device Type Earth Failure Device
definition: Definition from IAI: An earth failure device acts to protect people and equipment from the effects of current leakage.

name: Property Set: Protective Device Type Fuse Disconnector
definition: Definition from IAI: A device that will electrically open the circuit after a period of prolonged, abnormal current flow.

name: Property Set: Protective Device Type Residual Current Circuit Breaker
definition: Definition from IAI: A residual current circuit breaker opens, closes or isolates a circuit and has short circuit and overload protection.

name: Property Set: Protective Device Type Residual Current Switch
definition: Definition from IAI: A residual current switch opens, closes or isolates a circuit and has no short circuit or overload protection.

name: Property Set: Protective Device Type Varistor
definition: Definition from IAI: A high voltage surge protection device.

name: Property Set: Switching Device Type Common
definition: Definition from IEC 441-14-01: A switching device is a device designed to make or break the current in one or more electric circuits.

name: Property Set: Switching Device Type Contactor
definition: Definition from IAI: An electrical device used to control the flow of power in a circuit on or off.

name: Property Set: Switching Device Type Emergency Stop
definition: Definition from IEC 826-08-03: An emergency stop device acts to remove as quickly as possible any danger that may have arisen unexpectedly.

name: Property Set: Switching Device Type Starter
definition: Definition from IAI: A starter is a switch which in the closed position controls the application of power to an electrical device.

name: Property Set: Switching Device Type Switch Disconnector
definition: Definition from IEC 441-14-12: A switch disconnector is a switch which in the open position satisfies the isolating requirements specified for a disconnector.

name: Property Set: Switching Device Type Toggle Switch
definition: Definition from IAI: A toggle switch is a switch that enables or isolates electrical power through a two position on/off action..

name: Property Set: Transformer Type Common
definition: Definition from IAI: An inductive stationary device that transfers electrical energy from one circuit to another.

name: Property Set: Action Request
definition: Definition from IAI: An action request is a request for an action to fulfill a need.

name: Property Set: Packing Instructions
definition: Definition from IAI: Packing instructions are specific instructions relating to the packing that is required for an artefact (instance of IfcProduct) in the event of a move (where the product is related to an instance of IfcMove).

name: Property Set: Permit
definition: Definition from IAI: A permit is a document that allows permission to gain access to an area or carry out work in a situation where security or other access restrictions apply.

name: Property Set: Tank Type Pressure Vessel
definition: Definition from IAI: Common attributes of a pressure vessel.

name: Property Set: Tank Type Sectional
definition:
Definition from IAI: Fixed vessel constructed from sectional parts with one or more compartments for storing a liquid.

Note (1): All sectional construction tanks are considered to be rectangular by default.
Note (2): Generally, it is not expected that sectional construction tanks will be used for the purposes of gas storage.

Pset renamed from Pset_TankTypeSectionalTank to Pset_TankTypeSectional in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum.

name: Property Set: Unitary Equipment Type Air Handler
definition:
Definition from IAI: Air handler unitary equipment type attributes.
Note that these attributes were formerly Pset_AirHandler prior to IFC2x2.

name: Property Set: Valve PHistory
definition: Definition from IAI: Valve performance history common attributes of a typical 2 port pattern type valve.

name: Property Set: Valve Type Air Release
definition:
Definition from IAI: Valve used to release air from a pipe or fitting. 
Note that an air release valve is constrained to have a single port pattern

name: Property Set: Valve Type Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Valve type common attributes.

name: Property Set: Valve Type Draw Off Cock
definition: Definition from BS6100 250 6223: A small diameter valve, used to drain water from a cistern or water filled system.

name: Property Set: Valve Type Faucet
definition: Definition from BS6100: A small diameter valve, with a free outlet, from which water is drawn.

name: Property Set: Valve Type Flushing
definition:
Definition from IAI: Valve that flushes a predetermined quantity of water to cleanse a WC, urinal or slop hopper.
Note that a flushing valve is constrained to have a 2 port  pattern.

name: Property Set: Valve Type Gas Tap
definition: Definition from IAI: A small diameter valve, used to discharge gas from a system.

name: Property Set: Valve Type Isolating
definition:
Definition from IAI: Valve that is used to isolate system components.
Note that an isolating valve is constrained to have a 2 port  pattern.

name: Property Set: Valve Type Mixing
definition: Definition from IAI: A valve where typically the temperature of the outlet is determined by mixing hot and cold water inlet flows.

name: Property Set: Valve Type Pressure Reducing
definition:
Definition from IAI: Valve that reduces the pressure of a fluid immediately downstream of its position in a pipeline to a preselected value or by a predetermined ratio.
Note that a pressure reducing valve is constrained to have a 2 port  pattern.

name: Property Set: Valve Type Pressure Relief
definition:
Definition from IAI: Spring or weight loaded valve that automatically discharges to a safe place fluid that has built up to excessive pressure in pipes or fittings.
Note that a pressure relief valve is constrained to have a single port pattern.

name: Property Set: Vibration Isolator Type Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Vibration isolator type common attributes.

name: Property Set: Actor Common
definition: Definition from IAI: A property set that enables further classification of actors, including the ability to give a number of actors to be designated as a population, the number being specified as a property to be dealt with as a single value rather than having to aggregate a number of instances of IfcActor.

name: Property Set: Product Requirements
definition: Definition from IAI: Categorization of the required properties of an entity that are used to determine what the level of the requirement is, to enable its performance/quality to be determined, assessed, or measured, and compared against the requirement, and then to analyze whether the entity is suitable for use within a given context..

name: Property Set: Project Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Common properties for a building project.

name: Property Set: Design Point
definition: Definition from IAI:  A point of connection taken as a reference for hydraulic calculations in sprinkler systems. The point is assigned to an instance of IfcDistributionPort and located according to circumstances as set out by local building codes. For instance, it may be either the last elbow, tee or branch downstream of which a sprinkler array is located (where ranges are directly connected to the distribution pipe without risers or drops) or the point of connection of the riser or drop nearest the installation valves in the sprinkler array (where ranges are connected to the distribution pipe with risers or drops). Other circumstances may be referenced in local codes and the assignment of the design point must be established by a user.

name: Property Set: Drainage Catchment
definition:
Definition from IAI: Area of land that drains naturally to a given point (BS6100 modified). Used as a non type driven property set in conjunction with an appropriate instance of IfcSpatialStructureElement that is identified as a catchment using the inherited IfcRoot.Name attribute. Catchments may be nested using IfcRelNests so that subcatchment areas (as component parts of a catchment area) can be identified. A catchment area will be geometrically defined by a closed loop (closed polyline or polyloop)
Note also that the boundary between catchment areas (watershed) is not currently identified.

name: Property Set: Drainage Culvert
definition: Definition from IAI: Covered channel or large pipe that forms a watercourse below ground level, usually under a road or railway (BS6100). Used as a non type driven property set in conjunction with an instance of IfcSystem that is classified as a culvert.

name: Property Set: Drainage Outfall
definition: Definition from IAI: Structure through which water is discharged into a watercourse or body of water (BS6100). Used as a non type driven property set in conjunction with an instance of IfcProxy that is identified as an outfall using the inherited IfcRoot.Name attribute.

name: Property Set: Drainage Reserve
definition: Definition from IAI: Area exclusively reserved for the routing of drainage services. Used as a non type driven property set in conjunction with an appropriate instance of IfcSpatialStructureElement that is identified as a drainage reserve using the inherited IfcRoot.Name attribute.

name: Property Set: Fire Suppression Terminal Type Breeching Inlet
definition: Definition from IAI: Symmetrical pipe fitting that unites two or more inlets into a single pipe (BS6100 330 114 adapted).

name: Property Set: Fire Suppression Terminal Type Fire Hydrant
definition:
Definition from IAI: Device, fitted to a pipe, through which a temporary supply of water may be provided (BS6100 330 6107)

For further details on fire hydrants, see www.firehydrant.org

name: Property Set: Fire Suppression Terminal Type Hose Reel
definition:
Definition from IAI: A supporting framework on which a hose may be wound (BS6100 155 8201).

Note that the service provided by the hose (water/foam) is determined by the context of the system onto which the hose reel is connected.

name: Property Set: Fire Suppression Terminal Type Sprinkler
definition: Definition from IAI: Device for sprinkling water from a pipe under pressure over an area (BS6100 100 3432)

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type Bath
definition: Definition from IAI: Sanitary appliance for immersion of the human body or parts of it (BS6100).

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type Bidet
definition: Definition from IAI: Waste water appliance for washing the excretory organs while sitting astride the bowl (BS6100)

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type Cistern
definition: Definition from IAI: A water storage unit attached to a sanitary terminal that is fitted with a device, operated automatically or by the user, that discharges water to cleanse a water closet (toilet) pan, urinal or slop hopper. (BS6100 330 5008)

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type Sanitary Fountain
definition: Definition from IAI: A sanitary terminal that provides a low pressure jet of water for a specific purpose (IAI).

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type Shower
definition: Definition from IAI: Installation or waste water appliance that emits a spray of water to wash the human body (BS6100).

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type Sink
definition: Definition from IAI: Waste water appliance for receiving, retaining or disposing of domestic, culinary, laboratory or industrial process liquids.

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type Toilet Pan
definition: Definition from IAI: Soil appliance for the disposal of excrement.

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type Urinal
definition: Definition from IAI: Soil appliance that receives urine and directs it to a waste outlet (BS6100)

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type Wash Hand Basin
definition: Definition from IAI: Waste water appliance for washing the upper parts of the body.

name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Type WCSeat
definition: Definition from IAI: Hinged seat that fits on the top of a water closet (WC) pan. (BS6100 330 1401)

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Floor Trap
definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting, set into the floor, that retains liquid to prevent the passage of foul air.

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Floor Waste
definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting, set into the floor, that collects waste water and discharges it to a separate trap.

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Grease Interceptor
definition: Definition from IAI: Chamber, on the line of a drain or discharge pipe, that prevents grease passing into a drainage system (BS6100 330 6205).

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Gully Sump
definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting or assembly of fittings to receive surface water or waste water, fitted with a grating or sealed cover.

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Gully Trap
definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting or assembly of fittings to receive surface water or waste water, fitted with a grating or sealed cover and discharging through a trap (BS6100 330 3504 modified)

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Oil Interceptor
definition: Definition from IAI: One or more chambers arranged to prevent the ingress of oil to a drain or sewer, that retain the oil for later removal (BS6100 330 67316).

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Petrol Interceptor
definition: Definition from IAI: Two or more chambers with inlet and outlet pipes arranged to allow petrol/gasoline collected on the surface of water drained into them to evaporate through ventilating pipes.

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Roof Drain
definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting, set into the roof, that collects rainwater for discharge into the rainwater system.

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Waste Disposal Unit
definition: Definition from IAI: Electrically operated device that reduces kitchen or other waste into fragments small enough to be flushed into a drainage system.

name: Property Set: Waste Terminal Type Waste Trap
definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting, set adjacent to a sanitary terminal, that retains liquid to prevent the passage of foul air.

name: Property Set: Building Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuilding. Please note that several building attributes are handled directly at the IfcBuilding instance, the building number (or short name) by IfcBuilding.Name, the building name (or long name) by IfcBuilding.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcBuilding.Description. Actual building quantities, like building perimeter, building area and building volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and the building classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference.

name: Property Set: Building Element Proxy Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuildingElementProxy.

name: Property Set: Building Storey Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuildingStorey. Please note that several building attributes are handled directly at the IfcBuildingStorey instance, the building storey number (or short name) by IfcBuildingStorey.Name, the building storey name (or long name) by IfcBuildingStorey.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcBuildingStorey.Description. Actual building storey quantities, like building storey perimeter, building storey area and building storey volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and the building storey classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference.

name: Property Set: Building Use
definition: Definition from IAI: Provides information on on the real estate context of the building of interest both current and anticipated.

name: Property Set: Building Use Adjacent
definition: Definition from IAI: Provides information on adjacent buildings and their uses to enable their impact on the building of interest to be determined. Note that for each instance of the property set used, where there is an existence of risk, there will be an instance of the property set Pset_Risk (q.v)

name: Property Set: Building Water Storage
definition:
The basic set of properties that are used for determining the water requirements for a building.
Typically, this property set is expected to be used in conjunction with IfcBuilding.

name: Property Set: Covering Ceiling
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcCovering with the PredefinedType set to CEILING.

name: Property Set: Covering Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcCovering.

name: Property Set: Covering Flooring
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcCovering with the PredefinedType set to FLOORING.

name: Property Set: Draughting
definition:
Definition from IAI: Property set to capture layer and colour as a quick win implementation within IFC2x platform to enable more efficient exchange of 3D building models.
NOTE: With implementation of the IFC2x2 capabilities defined in the presentation resources (IfcPresentationLayerAssignment, IfcCurveStyle) the use of this property set may become obsolete.

name: Property Set: Element Shading
definition: Definition from IAI: Shading device properties associated with an element that represents a shading device, e.g. an IfcBuildingElementProxy or any other building element.

name: Property Set: Opening Element Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcOpeningElement.

name: Property Set: Quantity Take Off
definition: Definition from IAI: Description of quantities for work items to be exchanged in addition to the IfcElementQuantity

name: Property Set: Site Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSite. Please note that several site attributes are handled directly at the IfcSite instance, the site number (or short name) by IfcSite.Name, the site name (or long name) by IfcSite.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcSite.Description. The land title number is also given as an explicit attribute IfcSite.LandTitleNumber. Actual site quantities, like site perimeter, site area and site volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and site classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference. The global positioning of the site in terms of Northing and Easting and height above sea level datum is given by IfcSite.RefLongitude, IfcSite.RefLatitude, IfcSite.RefElevation and the postal address by IfcSite.SiteAddress.

name: Property Set: Space Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace. Please note that several space attributes are handled directly at the IfcSpace instance, the space number (or short name) by IfcSpace.Name, the space name (or long name) by IfcSpace:LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcSpace.Description. Actual space quantities, like space perimeter, space area and space volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and space classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference. The level above zero (relative to the building) for the slab row construction is provided by the IfcBuildingStorey.Elevation, the level above zero (relative to the building) for the floor finish is provided by the IfcSpace.ElevationWithFlooring.

name: Property Set: Space Fire Safety Requirements
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties related to fire protection of spaces that apply to the occurrences of IfcSpace or IfcZone.

name: Property Set: Space Lighting Requirements
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties related to the lighting requirements that apply to the occurrences of IfcSpace or IfcZone. This includes the required artificial lighting, illuminance, etc.

name: Property Set: Space Occupancy Requirements
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties concerning work activities occurring or expected to occur within one or a set of similar spatial structure elements.

name: Property Set: Space Parking
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace which have an attribute value for ObjectType = 'Parking'. NOTE: Modified in IFC 2x3, properties ParkingUse and ParkingUnits added.

name: Property Set: Space Parking Aisle
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace which have an attribute value for ObjectType = 'ParkingAisle'.

name: Property Set: Space Thermal Requirements
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties related to the comfort requirements for thermal and other  thermal related performances of spaces that apply to the occurrences of IfcSpace or IfcZone. This includes the required design temperature, humidity, and air conditioning.

name: Property Set: Transport Element Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcTransportElement.

name: Property Set: Transport Element Elevator
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcTransportElement with the predefined type ="ELEVATOR"

name: Property Set: Zone Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcZone.

name: Property Set: Beam Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcBeam.

name: Property Set: Column Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcColumn.

name: Property Set: Curtain Wall Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcCurtainWall.

name: Property Set: Door Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcDoor.

name: Property Set: Door Window Glazing Type
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of the glazing component of occurrences of IfcDoor and IfcWindow, used for thermal and lighting calculations.

name: Property Set: Door Window Shading Type
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of the shading component of occurrences of IfcDoor and IfcWindow, used for static (simplified) shading calculations.

name: Property Set: Member Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcMember.

name: Property Set: Plate Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcPlate.

name: Property Set: Railing Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcRailing.

name: Property Set: Ramp Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcRamp.

name: Property Set: Ramp Flight Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcRampFlight.

name: Property Set: Roof Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcRoof. Note: Properties for ProjectedArea and TotalArea added in IFC 2x3

name: Property Set: Slab Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSlab. Note: Properties for PitchAngle added in IFC 2x3

name: Property Set: Stair Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcStair.

name: Property Set: Stair Flight Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcStairFlight.

name: Property Set: Wall Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcWall and IfcWallStandardCase.

name: Property Set: Window Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of Window.

name: Property Set: Air Side System Information
definition: Definition from IAI: Attributes that apply to an air side HVAC system. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0.

name: Property Set: Distribution Chamber Element Type Formed Duct
definition: Definition from BS6100 100 3410: Space formed in the ground for the passage of pipes, cables, ducts.

name: Property Set: Distribution Chamber Element Type Inspection Chamber
definition: Definition from IAI: Chamber constructed on a drain, sewer or pipeline and with a removable cover, that permits visible inspection.

name: Property Set: Distribution Chamber Element Type Inspection Pit
definition: Definition from IAI: Recess or chamber formed to permit access for inspection of substructure and services (definition modified from BS6100 221 4128).

name: Property Set: Distribution Chamber Element Type Manhole
definition: Definition from IAI: Chamber constructed on a drain, sewer or pipeline and with a removable cover, that permits the entry of a person.

name: Property Set: Distribution Chamber Element Type Meter Chamber
definition: Definition from IAI: Chamber that houses a meter(s) (definition modified from BS6100 250 6224).

name: Property Set: Distribution Chamber Element Type Sump
definition: Definition from BS6100 100 3431: Recess or small chamber into which liquid is drained to facilitate its removal.

name: Property Set: Distribution Chamber Element Type Trench
definition: Definition from BS6100 221 4118: Excavation, the length of which greatly exceeds the width.

name: Property Set: Distribution Chamber Element Type Valve Chamber
definition: Definition from BS6100 250 6224: Chamber that houses a valve(s).

name: Property Set: Distribution Flow Element Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Common properties of all occurrences of IfcDistributionFlowElement and their subtypes.

name: Property Set: Distribution Port Duct
definition: Definition from IAI: Duct port occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcDistributionPort.

name: Property Set: Distribution Port Pipe
definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe port occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcDistributionPort.

name: Property Set: Energy Conversion Device Coil
definition: Definition from IAI: Coil occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcEnergyConversionDevice.

name: Property Set: Energy Conversion Device Space Heater Panel
definition: Definition from IAI: Panel space heater type occurrence attributes.

name: Property Set: Energy Conversion Device Space Heater Sectional
definition: Definition from IAI: Sectional space heater type occurrence attributes.

name: Property Set: Fire Rating Properties
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties related to the combustion of materials for purposes of assessing fire hazard.

name: Property Set: Flow Controller Damper
definition: Definition from IAI: Damper occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowController.

name: Property Set: Flow Controller Flow Meter
definition: Definition from IAI: Flow meter occurrence common attributes.

name: Property Set: Flow Fitting Duct Fitting
definition: Definition from IAI: Duct fitting occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowFitting.

name: Property Set: Flow Fitting Pipe Fitting
definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowFitting.

name: Property Set: Flow Moving Device Compressor
definition: Definition from IAI: Compressor occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowMovingDevice.

name: Property Set: Flow Moving Device Fan
definition: Definition from IAI: Fan occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowMovingDevice.

name: Property Set: Flow Moving Device Fan Centrifugal
definition: Definition from IAI: Centrifugal fan occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowMovingDevice.

name: Property Set: Flow Moving Device Pump
definition: Definition from IAI: Pump occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowMovingDevice.

name: Property Set: Flow Segment Duct Segment
definition: Definition from IAI: Duct segment occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowSegment.

name: Property Set: Flow Segment Pipe Segment
definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe segment occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowSegment.

name: Property Set: Flow Storage Device Tank
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties that relate to an instance of a flow storage device that is typed as a tank. Note that a partial tank may be considered as a compartment within a compartmentalized tank.

name: Property Set: Flow Terminal Air Terminal
definition: Definition from IAI: Air terminal occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowTerminal.

name: Property Set: Outside Design Criteria
definition: Definition from IAI: Outside air conditions used as the basis for calculating thermal loads at peak conditions, as well as the weather data location from which these conditions were obtained. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0.

name: Property Set: Space Thermal Design
definition: Definition from IAI: Space or zone HVAC design requirements. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0 (Pset_SpaceHvacInformation); renamed to Pset_SpaceThermalDesign and revised in IFC2x2.

name: Property Set: Thermal Load Aggregate
definition: Definition from IAI: The aggregated thermal loads experienced by one or many spaces, zones, or buildings. This aggregate thermal load information is typically addressed by a system or plant. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0 (Pset_AggregateLoadInformation); renamed Pset_ThermalLoadAggregate in IFC2x2.

name: Property Set: Thermal Load Design Criteria
definition: Definition from IAI: Building thermal load design data that are used for calculating thermal loads in a space or building. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0 (Pset_LoadDesignCriteria); renamed Pset_ThermalLoadDesignCriteria in IFC2x2.

name: Property Set: Utility Consumption
definition: Definition from IAI: Consumption of utility resources, typically applied to the IfcBuilding instance, used to identify how much was consumed on I.e., a monthly basis.

name: Property Set: Discrete Accessory Anchor Bolt
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to different types of anchor bolts.

name: Property Set: Discrete Accessory Column Shoe
definition: Definition from IAI: Shape properties common to column shoes.

name: Property Set: Discrete Accessory Corner Fixing Plate
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties specific to corner fixing plates.

name: Property Set: Discrete Accessory Diagonal Truss Connector
definition: Definition from IAI: Shape properties specific to connecting accessories in truss form with diagonal cross-bars.

name: Property Set: Discrete Accessory Edge Fixing Plate
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties specific to edge fixing plates.

name: Property Set: Discrete Accessory Fixing Socket
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to fixing sockets.

name: Property Set: Discrete Accessory Ladder Truss Connector
definition: Definition from IAI: Shape properties specific to connecting accessories in truss form with straight cross-bars in ladder shape.

name: Property Set: Discrete Accessory Standard Fixing Plate
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties specific to standard fixing plates.

name: Property Set: Discrete Accessory Wire Loop
definition: Definition from IAI: Shape properties common to wire loop joint connectors.

name: Property Set: Asset
definition: Definition from IAI: An asset is a uniquely identifiable element which has a financial value and against which maintenance actions are recorded.

name: Property Set: Furniture Type Chair
definition: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for furniture type chair. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Chair

name: Property Set: Furniture Type Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Common properties for all types of furniture such as chair, desk, table, and file cabinet. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_FurnitureCommon

name: Property Set: Furniture Type Desk
definition: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for furniture type desk. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Desk

name: Property Set: Furniture Type File Cabinet
definition: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for furniture type file cabinet HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_FileCabinet

name: Property Set: Furniture Type Table
definition: A set of specific properties for furniture type table. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Table

name: Property Set: Manufacturer Occurrence
definition: Definition from IAI: Defines properties of individual instances of manufactured products that may be given by the manufacturer.

name: Property Set: Manufacturer Type Information
definition:
Definition from IAI: Defines characteristics of manufactured products that may be given by the manufacturer. Note that the term 'manufactured' may also be used to refer to products that are supplied and identified by the supplier or that are assembled off site by a third party provider. 
This property set replaces the entity IfcManufacturerInformation from previous IFC releases.

name: Property Set: Property Agreement
definition:
Definition from IAI: A property agreement is an agreement that enables the occupation of a property for a period of time.

The objective is to capture the information within an  agreement that is relevant to a facilities manager. Design and construction information associated with the property is not considered. A property agreement may be applied to an instance of IfcSpatialStructureElement including to compositions defined through the IfcSpatialStructureElement.Element.CompositionEnum.

Note that the associated actors are captured by the IfcOccupant class.

name: Property Set: Reliability
definition: Definition from IAI: Indication of the expected reliability of a product

name: Property Set: Risk
definition:
Definition from IAI: An indication of exposure to mischance, peril, menace, hazard or loss. 

HISTORY: Extended in IFC2x3

There are various types of risk that may be encountered and there may be several instances of Pset_Risk associated in an instance of an IfcObject (either a physical object, a grouping of physical objects such as an asset or a process).
Specification of this property set incorporates the values of the Incom risk analysis matrix (satisfying AS/NZS 4360) together with additional identified requirements.

name: Property Set: System Furniture Element Type Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Common properties for all systems furniture (I.e. modular furniture) element types (e.g. vertical panels, work surfaces, and storage). HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_FurnitureElementCommon

name: Property Set: System Furniture Element Type Panel
definition: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for vertical panels that assembly workstations.. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Panel

name: Property Set: System Furniture Element Type Work Surface
definition: Definition from IAI: A set of specific properties for work surfaces used in workstations. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Worksurface

name: Property Set: Warranty
definition: Definition from IAI: An assurance given by the seller or provider of an artefact that the artefact is without defects and will operate as described for a defined period of time without failure and that if a defect does arise during that time, that it will be corrected by the seller or provider.

name: Property Set: Project Order Change Order
definition: Definition from IAI: A change order is an instruction to make a change to a product or work being undertake. Note that the change order status is defined in the same way as a work order status since a change order implies a work requirement.

name: Property Set: Project Order Maintenance Work Order
definition: Definition from IAI: A MaintenanceWorkOrder is a detailed description of maintenance work that is to be performed. Note that the Scheduled Frequency property of the maintenance work order is used when the order is required as an instance of a scheduled work order.

name: Property Set: Project Order Move Order
definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the requirements for move orders. Note that the move order status is defined in the same way as a work order status since a move order implies a work requirement.

name: Property Set: Project Order Purchase Order
definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the requirements for purchase orders in a project.

name: Property Set: Project Order Work Order
definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the requirements for purchase orders in a project.

name: Property Set: Concrete Element General
definition: Definition from IAI: General properties common to different types of concrete elements. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement.

name: Property Set: Concrete Element Quantity General
definition: Definition from IAI: Bill-of-Quantity properties common to different types of precast concrete elements. The Pset is used to express the total bulk quantities per element. The quantities may include the concrete, reinforcement, and different kinds of accessories. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement. Note: Bulk quantities for parts used for surface finish, tiles, bricks, etc. are included as area quantities in Pset_ConcreteElementSurfaceFinishQuantityGeneral.

name: Property Set: Concrete Element Surface Finish Quantity General
definition: Definition from IAI: Surface finish related properties common to different types of concrete elements. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement, like IfcBeam, IfcColumn, IfcWall, etc. If a precast concrete element is a sandwich wall panel each structural layer or shell represented by an IfcBuildingElementPart may be attached to a separate Pset.The surface finishes are expressed as area quantities only for each surface finish type. The exact details (location, area shape, overlaps, tile joints, patterns, etc.) of the surface finishes are expressed in external documents using the IfcDocumentReference mechanism. Each of the defined properties are instantiated as needed, and multiple instantiations of the same property for each different surface classification are possible.

name: Property Set: Precast Concrete Element General
definition: Definition from IAI: Production and manufacturing related properties common to different types of precast concrete elements. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement. If the precast concrete element is a sandwich wall panel each structural layer or shell represented by an IfcBuildingElementPart may be attached to a separate Pset of this type, if needed. Some of the properties apply only for specific types of precast concrete elements.

name: Property Set: Reinforcement Bar Count Of Independent Footing
definition: Definition from IAI: Reinforcement Concrete parameter [ST-2]: The amount number information of reinforcement  bar with the independent footing. The X and Y direction are based on the local coordinate system of building storey. The X and Y direction of the reinforcement bar are parallel to the X and Y axis of the IfcBuildingStorey's local coordinate system, respectively.

name: Property Set: Reinforcement Bar Pitch Of Beam
definition: Definition from IAI: The ptich length information of reinforcement  bar with the beam.

name: Property Set: Reinforcement Bar Pitch Of Column
definition: Definition from IAI: The pitch length information of reinforcement  bar with the column. The X and Y direction are based on the local coordinate system of building storey. The X and Y direction of the reinforcement bar are parallel to the X and Y axis of the IfcBuildingStorey's local coordinate system, respectively.

name: Property Set: Reinforcement Bar Pitch Of Continuous Footing
definition: Definition from IAI: Reinforcement Concrete parameter [ST-2]: The pitch length information of reinforcement  bar with the continuous footing.

name: Property Set: Reinforcement Bar Pitch Of Slab
definition: Definition from IAI: The pitch length information of reinforcement  bar with the slab.

name: Property Set: Reinforcement Bar Pitch Of Wall
definition: Definition from IAI: The pitch length information of reinforcement  bar with the wall.

name: Property Set: Reinforcing Bar Bendings BECCommon
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are defined according to the local Finnish BEC standard with minor adjustements (only bar bending information is included). The bending shape property definitions apply to both reinforcing bars (IfcReinforcingBar) and reinforcing meshes (IfcReinforcingMesh). It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism.

name: Property Set: Reinforcing Bar Bendings BS8666 Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are largely defined according to BS8666. It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism.

name: Property Set: Reinforcing Bar Bendings DIN135610 Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are largely defined according to DIN 1356 Teil 10 with some minor omissions: the shape type X2 is not considered since it is better represented by the explicit shape geometry. It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism. Note: This bending standard is presumably to be replaced by the upcoming ISO 3766 standard.

name: Property Set: Reinforcing Bar Bendings ISOCD3766 Common
definition: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are largely defined according to ISO/CD 3766 with some minor changes in how the hooks are defined (explicit angle measures instead of coded parameters). It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism. Note: This standard is still under development and the Pset will be changed accordingly if so required.
